Ledn is a centralized, custodial platform rather than a permissionless smart contract protocol. Ledn offers loans secured by cryptocurrency collateral. Ledn also offers interest-earning accounts for crypto holdings.

Nexo is a centralized, custodial crypto lending platform rather than a permissionless smart contract protocol. Nexo offers loans secured by cryptocurrency collateral. Nexo also offers interest-earning accounts for crypto holdings.

0x Protocol is an open-source protocol for decentralized exchange of crypto assets. 0x Protocol is built on the Ethereum blockchain and uses smart contracts to settle trades. 0x Protocol is non-custodial, so users trade directly from their own wallets.

Bancor is a decentralized exchange protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Bancor uses an automated market maker model with bonding curves to price trades. Bancor allows liquidity providers to supply single-sided liquidity to its pools. Bancor uses its own native token, BNT, within its protocol.

Augur is a decentralized prediction market protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Augur uses smart contracts to create and settle markets without a central operator. Augur uses its native token, REP, for reporting on market outcomes.
